question: When was the Basel Convention adopted on the Control of Transboundary Movements of Hazardous Wastes and their Disposal?
solution:
The correct answer is __**1989**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **Basel Convention** was adopted on **22 March 1989** as an international treaty designed to control the **transboundary movements of hazardous wastes** and their disposal.
 
• The primary aim of the Basel Convention is to protect **human health and the environment** against the adverse effects of hazardous waste.
 
• The Convention establishes a framework for the **global management of hazardous wastes**, especially preventing their transfer from developed to developing countries. *Hence, the correct answer is 1989.*
 
• The treaty entered into force on **5 May 1992**, following its ratification by a sufficient number of countries.
